name: Zawhar Dudayev Haque
title: Assistant Industrial & Organisational Psychologist
shortBio: Assistant Industrial and Organisational Psychologist with postgraduate training from the University of Dhaka, focused on workplace behaviour, employee wellbeing, resilience and organisational development.
bio: Zawhar Dudayev Haque is an Assistant Industrial and Organisational Psychologist with postgraduate training in Industrial-Organisational Psychology from the University of Dhaka. His academic background focuses on workplace behaviour, employee wellbeing, organisational development and the psychological factors influencing motivation, engagement and performance.

He completed a 100-hour professional training programme titled Building Resilient Mind: Organisational Mental Health at the University of Dhaka, covering workplace mental health, stress and anxiety management, mindfulness, anger management, communication, time management, digital wellbeing, employee motivation and executive coaching skills.

His professional experience includes an HR and Administration internship at Grameen Telecom Trust, where he supported recruitment, employee records, HR coordination and organisational processes. He also worked with Mindwizz in HR and outreach, contributing to workplace wellbeing research, training materials, employee engagement analysis and the coordination of mental health awareness programmes and workshops.

His academic research includes studies examining the relationship between personality traits and academic motivation, and comparisons of sleep quality and job satisfaction among day- and night-shift workers.

Through Ardor Psychology's proposed Corporate Training & Organisational Development programme, Zawhar will focus on workplace mental health awareness, resilience, stress management, employee engagement and the development of psychologically supportive work environments.
qualifications: MSc Industrial-Organisational Psychology, University of Dhaka (2024–2026; CGPA 3.74/4.00, 3rd position)
100-hour training in Building Resilient Mind: Organisational Mental Health, University of Dhaka
Training in Human Resource Management (8 hours) and SPSS (20 hours)
availability: Corporate training, interactive webinars, workplace wellbeing workshops and organisational development programmes — subject to prior arrangement and confirmation.
affiliations: Executive Member, Bangladesh Society for IO Psychology

name: Azwad Zaman
title: Assistant Industrial & Organisational Psychologist
shortBio: Assistant Industrial and Organisational Psychologist combining business psychology, organisational behaviour and corporate finance experience to support leadership, motivation and performance improvement.
bio: Azwad Zaman is an Assistant Industrial and Organisational Psychologist with postgraduate qualifications in Industrial and Organisational Psychology (Business Psychology) from the University of Dhaka. His academic background combines psychological science, organisational behaviour, business management and professional accountancy.

He has corporate experience in finance, internal audit, operational processes and business performance. He currently works as an Executive in Finance at Epic Group, where his responsibilities include financial reporting, costing analysis, business planning and variance analysis. Previously, as an Internal Audit Trainee at Epic Group, he contributed to standard operating procedures, internal control assessments, process reviews and operational analysis. He also completed an Accounts and Finance internship at The Daily Star.

His academic research examined the impact of motivational videos on entrepreneurial behaviour, using questionnaire-based data collection, purposive sampling and quantitative statistical analysis. His interests include workplace motivation, employee performance, leadership, organisational behaviour and the relationship between psychological factors and business decision-making.

Through Ardor Psychology's proposed Corporate Training & Organisational Development programme, Azwad will focus on leadership development, employee motivation, team effectiveness, organisational behaviour, workplace productivity and performance improvement.

His combined academic background in psychology and practical corporate experience enables him to approach organisational challenges through both behavioural and business perspectives, supporting research-informed training and organisational development initiatives.
qualifications: MSc Industrial & Organisational Psychology (Business Psychology), University of Dhaka (CGPA 3.46/4.00)
BSc (Hons) Applied Accounting, Oxford Brookes University
availability: Corporate training, interactive webinars, leadership workshops, team development programmes and organisational performance training — subject to prior arrangement and confirmation.
